scope: Managed rift destination guard: DD's rift configuration tool rewrites RiftBlockEntity destinations directly, bypassing all block write paths; bridge-owned targets and protected rift positions now refuse foreign targets.

riftGuard.rule: setDestination is refused when the current target is bridge-owned (ManagedExitTarget/ManagedEntranceTarget) or the rift sits on a protected position, unless the next target is also bridge-owned. System installation paths always set bridge-owned targets, so they pass.
riftGuard.toolAudit: RiftConfigurationToolItem.onAttackBlock and use both call RiftBlockEntity.setDestination(new IdMarker(...)) on any rift. RiftRemoverItem and RiftBladeItem only target detached rifts (DetachedRiftBlockEntity) and never rewrite ordinary rift destinations.
riftGuard.contracts: DimDoorsRiftContractTest pins setDestination(VirtualTarget) injectability and the tool rewrite paths against the locked DD 5.4.4 JAR.
riftGuard.remaining: Internal-link rifts keep native destinations and are not bridged-owned; they remain position-protected only. Runtime acceptance for tool interactions and configuration flows is pending.

runtimeAcceptance: Current artifact NOT_RUNTIME_TESTED. No installation to any instance.
notes: Full 91-class test run; definition policy remains 105/125. Formal pools and natural entrances remain closed.
